summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and the finished-time latch in rich/progress.py, added the progress.elapsed default style (yellow) in rich/default_styles.py, added an Unreleased Added entry to CHANGELOG.md, and added a unit test plus an updated test_columns expected string in tests/test_progress.py.
